title: Safar Zainabس ka
body:
BERIDAA SHAAM KI GALIYO MEI SAFAR ZAINAB KA
SAR HAY PATHAR SE HUWA KHOON MEI TAR ZAINAB KA
<<DIVIDER>>
GIR PARDHA KHAAK PE ABBAS KA SAR MAQTAL MEI
NOK E NEZA SE NA DEKHA GAYA SAR ZAINAB KA
<<DIVIDER>>
NOK E NEZA PE BHI ROTA REHA SHABIR KA SAR
KAAT TA JATA THA MANZAR YEH JIGAR ZAINAB KA
<<DIVIDER>>
HAR SEHAR ZULM NAYA AUR NAYI MUSHKIL HAR SHAAM
DARD BERTAA REHA HAR SHAAM O SEHAR ZAINAB KA
<<DIVIDER>>
HAYE BAZAAR MEI ABID KO MASAIB WO MILLE
HO GAYA BUDHA JAWAANI MEI PISAR ZAINAB KA
<<DIVIDER>>
EK RASSI MEI BANDHE DONO GALLE KHINJ TE TH
HAYE UDHAR BAALI SAKINA KA IDHAR ZAINAB KA
<<DIVIDER>>
EH KHUDDA SAKTH MUSIBAT KI GARRI MEI HAY DUA
KAASH IMDAAD KO AA JAYA PADAR ZAINAB KA
<<DIVIDER>>
KISKO AWAAZ BHALLA DEGI BULAAYEGI KISSE
HO CHUKA QATAL HAR EK NOOR E NAZAR ZAINAB KA
<<DIVIDER>>
ARSALAN AZMI SAB KHAAK HUWE SHIMR O YAZEED
AB BHI DARBAAR MEI BAAKI HAY ASAR ZAINAB KA
